- Handle edge cases: if the string is empty or ends with whitespace, return False; otherwise strip trailing whitespace only for inspection of last non-space character index.
- Identify the last non-space character; check if it is an alphabetical letter (isalpha). If not a letter, return False.
- Ensure this letter is not part of a word: verify that there is a space immediately before it (or it is at index 0). Return True only if previous character is a space or start of string.
